description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Textarea' that extends the base class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform' and provides a method to set default 'cols' and 'rows' attributes for <textarea> HTML elements if they are not already specified.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Textarea
classes.description: A class responsible for applying default attribute transformations to <textarea> elements to set default size attributes.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Sets default 'cols' and 'rows' attributes for the <textarea> element if they are not already set, based on typical Firefox calculations.
